records.jp: みんなで作った秘密基地……のつもりが、なぜか海の家みたいになっちゃった。でもこっちの方が、みんなでかき氷を食べたりできていいよね
records.en_original: We set out to build a secret hideout together...but it turned out more like a beachside cafe. It's better this way, though, because now we can eat shaved ice together!
records.en: We set out to build a secret hideout together...but it turned out more like a beachside cafe. It's better this way, though, because now we can eat shaved ice together!

records.jp: 星崎さんに勉強してもらうために外に置いた机と椅子。でも結局、勉強時間は全然増えていない気が……。まあ、外の方が気が散るものも多いし仕方ないかもね
records.en_original: I put this desk and chair outside to encourage Hoshizaki to study, but I don't think her study time has increased at all... Well, I guess there are a lot more potential distractions outside.
records.en: I put this desk and chair outside to encourage Hoshizaki-san to study, but I don't think her study time has increased at all... Well, I guess there are a lot more potential distractions outside.

records.jp: 南の島をイメージしたビーチチェアだよ！　それっぽいジュースも一緒に作ってみたんだけど、こっちはちょっと失敗かも……。でもこういうのは気分が大事だよね
records.en_original: A beach chair just like the ones you'd see on a tropical island! I tried to make some tropical juice to go with it, but that kind of failed... Either way, it's the vibe that counts, right?
records.en: A beach chair just like the ones you'd see on a tropical island! I tried to make some tropical juice to go with it, but that kind of failed... Either way, it's the vibe that counts, right?

records.jp: 木陰が気持ちいい大きな樹。植えてからそんなに経っていないのに、想いの力ですぐにここまで育っちゃった。甘い果物が実るから、たまに登って食べてるんだ
records.en_original: It's nice to sit in the shade of this tree. We didn't plant it so long ago, but we made it grow this tall with the power of our emotions. It also bears sweet fruit which we climb up to eat sometimes.
records.en: It's nice to sit in the shade of this tree. We didn't plant it so long ago, but we made it grow this tall with the power of our emotions. It also bears sweet fruit which we climb up to eat sometimes.

records.jp: 好きな時に飲み物や食べ物を買える自販機。いつでも冷えた飲み物が飲めるのはありがたいな。それにしても、まさかハンバーガーの自販機があるだなんて……
records.en_original: Vending machines where you can get food and drinks anytime. It's nice to be able to grab a cold drink whenever I want. Still, I never thought I'd see a hamburger vending machine...
records.en: Vending machines where you can get food and drinks anytime. It's nice to be able to grab a cold drink whenever I want. Still, I never thought I'd see a hamburger vending machine...

records.jp: ソースの香り漂うたこ焼きの屋台。やっぱりお祭りと言えばこれだよね。生地をきれいにひっくり返すのには、結構コツがいるのです
records.en_original: A takoyaki stand, complete with the smell of the sauce wafting through the air. You can't have a festival without it! Flipping the takoyaki does take some skill, though.
records.en: A takoyaki stand, complete with the smell of the sauce wafting through the air. You can't have a festival without it! Flipping the takoyaki does take some skill, though.

records.jp: みんなで作った、いい雰囲気のテラス席。食後の休憩のときに、コーヒーを淹れてここでみんなに振る舞うのがわたしの楽しみの一つです
records.en_original: A lovely little patio that we built together. One of my favorite things to do is to make coffee after dinner and serve it to everyone here.
records.en: A lovely little patio that we built together. One of my favorite things to do is to make coffee after dinner and serve it to everyone here.

records.jp: 探索で拾ったアサガオの種を植えた花壇ね。グリーン^00カーテンの実験用に育ててみたけど、大きさが足りないせいかあまり涼しくはならないみたい
records.en_original: This garden is where I planted the morning glory seeds I found while exploring. I tried to grow them into a green curtain as an experiment, but it didn't get tall enough to keep us cool.
records.en: This garden is where I planted the morning glory seeds I found while exploring. I tried to grow them into a green curtain as an experiment, but it didn't get tall enough to keep us cool.

records.jp: 木を積み上げて作ったキャンプファイヤー。いつか作ってみたいと思っていたけど、まさか学校でやることになるなんて。元の世界だったら、絶対に怒られてたよね
records.en_original: A bonfire made from a pile of wood. I've always wanted to build a bonfire, but I never thought I'd end up building one at school. We'd just get yelled at if we tried to do this in our world.
records.en: A bonfire made from a pile of wood. I've always wanted to build a bonfire, but I never thought I'd end up building one at school. We'd just get yelled at if we tried to do this in our world.

records.jp: 学校の中に作ってみた駅のホームです。電車は流石に乗り入れませんが……ベンチに座って風に当たっていると、旅をしているような気分を味わえますよ
records.en_original: This is a train platform that we built in the school. There's no train to ride, of course, but when you sit on the bench and feel the breeze, it's almost like you're travelling.
records.en: This is a train platform that we built in the school. There's no train to ride, of course, but when you sit on the bench and feel the breeze, it's almost like you're travelling.

records.jp: ゲーセンとかに置いてあるやつ！　夢中になって回しすぎると、お金がすぐに無くなっちゃうけど……やっぱりカプセルを開ける瞬間のわくわくには抗えないね！
records.en_original: A capsule machine just like the ones you see at arcades! It's easy to get carried away and keep turning that knob until you run out of money...but nothing beats the thrill of opening a capsule!
records.en: A capsule machine just like the ones you see at arcades! It's easy to get carried away and keep turning that knob until you run out of money...but nothing beats the thrill of opening a capsule!

records.jp: 人目を気にせずゆっくりできる空間。意外と広いから、大の字になって寝ることもできる。教室からランタンを持って来て、静かに読書をするのもいいかもね
records.en_original: A space where you can relax without worry. It's surprisingly spacious, so you can stretch out and sleep. If you bring a lantern from the classroom, you can read here in peace.
records.en: A space where you can relax without worry. It's surprisingly spacious, so you can stretch out and sleep. If you bring a lantern from the classroom, you can read here in peace.

records.jp: かなーり本格的な天体望遠鏡だよ。実はあたし天文学に興味があるんだよね……というのは冗談で、よく屋上で星を見てる伶那が喜ぶかなと思って提案してみたんだ
records.en_original: This is a pretty serious telescope. I'm actually super into astronomy, so... Just kidding. But Rena likes to stargaze on the rooftop, so I suggested building one for her.
records.en: This is a pretty serious telescope. I'm actually super into astronomy, so... Just kidding. But Rena likes to stargaze on the rooftop, so I suggested building one for her.

records.jp: カンフー映画の修行シーンで使われるやつ。飛び出た棒を人の手に見立てて、型の練習をするんだ。かっこいいよね、カンフー……私も練習してみようかな？
records.en_original: This is like something you see in kung fu movie dojo scenes. The parts that look like arms for you to practice moves with. Kung fu is so cool... Maybe I should learn too?
records.en: This is like something you see in kung fu movie dojo scenes. The parts that look like arms for you to practice moves with. Kung fu is so cool... Maybe I should learn too?

records.jp: 火を灯すとぼんやり光る灯籠。昔住んでた田舎の家の周りに、沢山置いてあったんだ。お祭りになると、火が^00灯って綺麗だったなぁ
records.en_original: Lanterns that glow dimly when lit. We had a lot of these around our house when I lived in the country. They looked so beautiful when we lit them during festivals.
records.en: Lanterns that glow dimly when lit. We had a lot of these around our house when I lived in the country. They looked so beautiful when we lit them during festivals.

records.jp: プールにお湯を溜めてお風呂にしてみたんだ。大きい看板も立てちゃったりして。気分は温泉の大浴場だね。^00はぁ……いつまでも浸かっていたいなぁ
records.en_original: We filled the pool with hot water and turned it into a bath. We even put up a big sign. It feels like the main bath at a hot spring. Ahh...I could soak in here forever.
records.en: We filled the pool with hot water and turned it into a bath. We even put up a big sign. It feels like the main bath at a hot spring. Ahh...I could soak in here forever.

records.jp: お花を散りばめたベッドです。寝たら崩れてしまいますが、ベッドは寝ないと意味がありません。それにもし崩れても、ベッドメイクは覚えたのでお任せください！
records.en_original: This bed is covered in flowers. It'll be ruined if someone sleeps on it, but a bed you can't sleep on isn't much use. Besides, I can always make the bed again!
records.en: This bed is covered in flowers. It'll be ruined if someone sleeps on it, but a bed you can't sleep on isn't much use. Besides, I can always make the bed again!

records.jp: 縁日でよく見る屋台です。景品を撃ち落とすと、それをもらうことができます。これが中々難しいのですが、熱中してお金を使いすぎないように気を付けないとですね
records.en_original: This is a shooting gallery like the kind you often see at festivals. If you shoot down a prize, you get to keep it. It's quite difficult, but it's easy to get carried away and spend too much money!
records.en: This is a shooting gallery like the kind you often see at festivals. If you shoot down a prize, you get to keep it. It's quite difficult, but it's easy to get carried away and spend too much money!

records.jp: 万が一学校が停電したときのために作った発電機。これで電気については一安心。……別に、真っ暗なのが怖いわけではないんだけど
records.en_original: I built this generator in case the school ever loses power. Now we can rest easy knowing we'll always have electricity. ...Not that I'm scared of the dark or anything.
records.en: I built this generator in case the school ever loses power. Now we can rest easy knowing we'll always have electricity. ...Not that I'm scared of the dark or anything.

records.jp: 丸くて穴の空いているものだ。しかも水が汲める。古びた石でできているから、怪談に出てきそうな雰囲気があるな。肝試しには持ってこいだ
records.en_original: A round structure with a hole in it, from which water can be drawn. It's made of old stones, so it looks like something out of a ghost story. This would be a good site for a dare.
records.en: A round structure with a hole in it, from which water can be drawn. It's made of old stones, so it looks like something out of a ghost story. This would be a good site for a dare.

records.jp: お米をいっぱい食べるために作ったたんぼ。これがあれば、山盛りのごはんをお腹いっぱい食べられる……。稲作は大変だけど、お米のことを思えば頑張れるのです
records.en_original: We planted this field so we have plenty of rice to eat. With this, we can stuff ourselves until we're about to burst! Rice farming is hard work, but thinking about all the rice we'll get motivates me.
records.en: We planted this field so we have plenty of rice to eat. With this, we can stuff ourselves until we're about to burst! Rice farming is hard work, but thinking about all the rice we'll get motivates me.

records.jp: コインを入れて動かす動物の乗り物ね。昔、遊園地へ^00行ったとき、陽桜莉がとても気に入っていたのを覚えている。元の世界に戻ったら、また一緒に行きたいわね
records.en_original: An animal ride that moves when you put coins into it. Hiori loved to ride these at the amusement park we used to go to long ago. I'd like to go with her again when we get back to our world.
records.en: An animal ride that moves when you put coins into it. Hiori loved to ride these at the amusement park we used to go to long ago. I'd like to go with her again when we get back to our world.

records.jp: 海辺とかにある屋外用のシャワーだよ。真夏の汗も、ここで流せばサッパリだ！　ただし水の勢いはかなり強いから、扱いには気を付けないとね
records.en_original: An outdoor shower like the ones you find by the beach. Wash off the summer sweat and feel refreshed! Careful, though—the water pressure is very strong.
records.en: An outdoor shower like the ones you find by the beach. Wash off the summer sweat and feel refreshed! Careful, though—the water pressure is very strong.

records.jp: 公園の遊具の主役、ブランコ！　座って漕ぐのも立って漕ぐのも楽しいけど、勢いをつけすぎると一回転しちゃうから要注意だよ！
records.en_original: Swings, a staple of playgrounds everywhere! It's fun to sit or even stand on them. Be careful not to swing too high, or you might go all the way around!
records.en: Swings, a staple of playgrounds everywhere! It's fun to sit or even stand on them. Be careful not to swing too high, or you might go all the way around!

records.jp: 短冊に願い事を書いて笹に吊るしてある。七夕の行事だな。短冊の他にも、カラフルな飾りを沢山付けているから、見ているだけで楽しめるな
records.en_original: We wrote our wishes on slips of paper and hung them on a bamboo stalk. It's a Tanabata tradition. We hung colorful decorations from the bamboo too, so it's fun just to look at it.
records.en: We wrote our wishes on slips of paper and hung them on a bamboo stalk. It's a Tanabata tradition. We hung colorful decorations from the bamboo too, so it's fun just to look at it.

records.jp: 夏祭りのおいしいものと言ったらりんご飴だよね。カ^00リッとした食感がたまらない！　赤くてつやつやした見た目も可愛いし、いつか浴衣を着て食べ歩きしたいなー
records.en_original: If there's one thing to eat at a summer festival, it's gotta be candy apples! I love biting into the candy coating, and they look so shiny and cute! I wanna eat one while wearing a yukata someday!
records.en: If there's one thing to eat at a summer festival, it's gotta be candy apples! I love biting into the candy coating, and they look so shiny and cute! I wanna eat one while wearing a yukata someday!

records.jp: 宇宙空間での活動を可能にする服ね。色々な機能を備えている代わりに、かなり重いらしいわ。支えなしで着たら、きっと後ろにひっくり返るんじゃないかしら
records.en_original: This suit allows you to survive in the vacuum of space. It has a lot of features, but that makes it very heavy. If you try to put it on without support, you might fall over backwards.
records.en: This suit allows you to survive in the vacuum of space. It has a lot of features, but that makes it very heavy. If you try to put it on without support, you might fall over backwards.

records.jp: 商店街の入り口に置いてあるゲートです。家が商店街にあったので、これを見ると懐かしい気持ちになります。元の世界に戻ったら、皆さんにも来てほしいですね
records.en_original: This is the type of sign you might find by the entrance of a shopping street. My house was on one, so it reminds me of home. I hope everyone will come and visit me in our world.
records.en: This is the type of sign you might find by the entrance of a shopping street. My house was on one, so it reminds me of home. I hope everyone will come and visit me in our world.

records.jp: 同人誌を売るスペース。私の描いた絵を見てもらえる場所を用意するために、みんなに作ってもらった。いつか元の世界で、本物のイベントにも参加してみたいな
records.en_original: A booth for selling comics. The others made this for me so that I could have a place to display my drawings. Someday, I'd like to sell my work at a real comic convention back in our world.
records.en: A booth for selling comics. The others made this for me so that I could have a place to display my drawings. Someday, I'd like to sell my work at a real comic convention back in our world.

records.jp: 星と月をぶら下げたベッド。一見まぶしそうだけど、見つめていると不思議と心穏やかになって眠れてしまうのよね。一体どうしてかしら……？
records.en_original: A bed with the stars and moon hanging above it. It may seem a bit bright, but the more you look at it, the more relaxed you feel, and before long you're drifting off. I wonder why...?
records.en: A bed with the stars and moon hanging above it. It may seem a bit bright, but the more you look at it, the more relaxed you feel, and before long you're drifting off. I wonder why...?

records.jp: ひまわりを植えた花壇だね。お姉ちゃんと住んでた街の近くにあった、大きなひまわり畑を思い出すな。やっぱ夏の景色にはこれがなくっちゃね！
records.en_original: These sunflowers remind me of the big sunflower field near the town where my sister and I lived. They just scream summer!
records.en: These sunflowers remind me of the huge sunflower field near the town where Onee-chan and I lived. They just scream summer!

records.jp: 神を祀る施設、お社だ。知識も技術もないきららたちが作った形だけのものだが、信じ続けていれば、いつか本物にも引けを取らないご利益が生まれるかもしれない
records.en_original: This is a shrine dedicated to the gods. It's just an imitation, as we lack the skills or knowledge to build a real one. But if we keep believing, it may someday grant us blessings like the real thing.
records.en: This is a shrine dedicated to the gods. It's just an imitation, as we lack the skills or knowledge to build a real one. But if we keep believing, it may someday grant us blessings like the real thing.

records.jp: 金魚すくいだ！　一度だけやったことがあるけど、全然上手く掬えなかったんだよね。ここなら掬い放題だから、沢山練習してお姉ちゃんをびっくりさせちゃおう！
records.en_original: Goldfish scooping! I've only tried it once, but I couldn't get any fish at all. We can scoop as much as we want here, so I'm gonna get lots of practice and blow Mio away with my skills!
records.en: Goldfish scooping! I've only tried it once, but I couldn't get any fish at all. We can scoop as much as we want here, so I'm going to practice a lot and surprise Onee-chan!

records.jp: とても大きくて、もふもふなぬいぐるみです。見つめていると、昔大切にしていたクマのぬいぐるみを思い出します。なぜだか、ずっと抱き着いていたくなりますね
records.en_original: A very large and very fluffy plushie. It reminds me of my old beloved teddy bear. Something about it just makes me want to hug it and never let go.
records.en: A very large and very fluffy plushie. It reminds me of my old beloved teddy bear. Something about it just makes me want to hug it and never let go.

records.jp: 港とかに置かれているコンテナ。物置として作ってみたけど、熱がこもりやすいから食料品は置けないね。石とか木材とか、かさばるものを保管しよう
records.en_original: A container like the ones you see at a harbor. We were going to use it for storage, but it gets really hot so we can't keep food in it. Maybe we can store stone and lumber in it.
records.en: A container like the ones you see at a harbor. We were going to use it for storage, but it gets really hot so we can't keep food in it. Maybe we can store stone and lumber in it.

records.jp: 夏といえばキャンプ！　折り畳みの椅子に座ってカレーを食べたり、夜に星を眺めたり、やりたいことが無限にあって……見てるだけでワクワクしちゃうよね！
records.en_original: Nothing says summer like camping! Sitting on folding chairs, eating curry, looking up at the stars... There's no limit to the fun you can have! Just looking at it makes me excited!
records.en: Nothing says summer like camping! Sitting on folding chairs, eating curry, looking up at the stars... There's no limit to the fun you can have! Just looking at it makes me excited!

records.jp: 手動で火を灯す形の、古風な街燈です。このような街燈は、古い本の中でしか知りませんでしたが、見つめているとどこか懐かしい気分になりますね
records.en_original: This is an old-fashioned street lamp that you had to light by hand. I've only read about them in books, but looking at it makes me feel a sense of nostalgia.
records.en: This is an old-fashioned street lamp that you had to light by hand. I've only read about them in books, but looking at it makes me feel a sense of nostalgia.

records.jp: 映画を見られる設備だ。幸い図書室には映画のディスクメディアもいくつかあったから、ここで再生することができる。みんなで映画フェスをやるのも悪くないな
records.en_original: A facility for watching movies. Fortunately the library has some movies that we can play here. Having a film festival with everyone here wouldn't be a bad idea.
records.en: A facility for watching movies. Fortunately the library has some movies that we can play here. Having a film festival with everyone here wouldn't be a bad idea.

records.jp: 有人飛行可能な宇宙船ね。実際に宇宙まで飛ぶかは分からないけれど、こんなものまで作れてしまうだなんて、想いの力は計り知れないわ
records.en_original: A spaceship capable of manned flight. I'm not sure if it will actually fly into outer space, but the fact that we were able to build it shows the immeasurable power of our emotions.
records.en: A spaceship capable of manned flight. I'm not sure if it will actually fly into outer space, but the fact that we were able to build it shows the immeasurable power of our emotions.

records.jp: 日本の原風景、縁側のある畳部屋！　ここでだらーって寝転んで、扇風機に当たりながらうたた寝するのが最高なんだぁ……棒アイスもあれば完璧だったのに！
records.en_original: A room with tatami mats and a veranda, the classic Japanese scene! It's a great place to lie down and take a nap under the fan. If only I had some ice cream!
records.en: A room with tatami mats and a veranda, the classic Japanese scene! It's a great place to lie down and take a nap under the fan. If only I had some ice cream!

records.jp: 美しいグランドピアノです。その透き通った音色は私のような人間の心も動かしてくれます。みなさんの心にも同じように響いているのでしょうか
records.en_original: A beautiful grand piano. Its crystal-clear tone moves even someone like me to my core. I wonder if it has the same effect on the others.
records.en: A beautiful grand piano. Its crystal-clear tone moves even someone like me to my core. I wonder if it has the same effect on the others.

records.jp: 野外フェスティバルの会場です。実際に行ったことはないのですが……元の世界に戻ったら、本物のコンサートにも行ってみたいですね。できれば、みなさんと一緒に
records.en_original: This is a venue for outdoor festivals. I have never been to one, but when we return to our world, I would like to see a real concert. I hope it would be with everyone else...
records.en: This is a venue for outdoor festivals. I have never been to one, but when we return to our world, I would like to see a real concert. I hope it would be with everyone else...

records.jp: 学校を魔改造すべく開発したビーチチェア。これがあれば夏の日差しもへっちゃらだね！
records.en_original: A beach chair developed for an extreme school makeover. Perfect for lounging during the summer!
records.en: A beach chair developed for an extreme school makeover. Perfect for lounging during the summer!

records.jp: 学校を魔改造すべく開発した動物の乗り物。つぶらな瞳がかわいいよね
records.en_original: An animal ride developed for an extreme school makeover. Isn't it just adorable?
records.en: An animal ride developed for an extreme school makeover. Isn't it just adorable?

records.jp: 写真を撮るためのちょっと本格的なスタジオ。こういうところでカメラ向けられると、芸能人にでもなったみたいだ。よし、今度水着で撮影会でも開くか！
records.en_original: A studio we made just for taking pictures! Getting in front of the camera in a place like this really makes you feel like a celebrity. Ooh, we should do a swimsuit shoot next!
records.en: A studio we made just for taking pictures! Getting in front of the camera in a place like this really makes you feel like a celebrity. Ooh, we should do a swimsuit shoot next!

records.jp: 夏だ！　プールだ！　ナイトプールだ！　普段のプールと場所も大きさも変わらないけど、夜に遊べるってだけでちょっとドキドキするかも？　さーて、泳ぐぞ！
records.en_original: Summer equals pool equals night swimming! Playing in the pool at night just sounds exciting, even if it is the same pool in the same place. OK, here I go! Cannonbaaaall!
records.en: Summer equals pool equals night swimming! Playing in the pool at night just sounds exciting, even if it is the same pool in the same place. OK, here I go! Cannonbaaaall!

records.jp: 花火を打ち上げるための大きな筒。筒も花火玉も実物は見たことなかったけど、みんなの想いを込めて作った花火なら、きっと綺麗で……おいしそうなはずなのです
records.en_original: A big cannon we use to launch fireworks. I've never seen a cannon or a firework shell in real life, but I'm sure what we make with our feelings will look really pretty...and tasty.
records.en: A big cannon we use to launch fireworks. I've never seen a cannon or a firework shell in real life, but I'm sure what we make with our feelings will look really pretty...and tasty.

records.jp: 普段と違う体験がしたくて作った気球。見慣れてきたこの学校も、空から見たら新しい発見があるかも。ところで命綱とか無いんだけど……大丈夫、よね？
records.en_original: We wanted to try something new, so we made this hot-air balloon. Who knows, maybe we'll see this old school differently from up high. Oh, we don't have a tether...but we should be fine, right?
records.en: We wanted to try something new, so we made this hot-air balloon. Who knows, maybe we'll see this old school differently from up high. Oh, we don't have a tether...but we should be fine, right?

records.jp: とある世界の錬金釜、を真似て作ってみました。これで練習すれば私も錬金術士に……ふへへ。学校にひっそりと建つ、アオのアトリエをどうぞご贔屓に、なんてね！
records.en_original: I made this based on a cauldron from another world. With some practice I can be an alchemist too! I'll secretly build my shop in the school. "Welcome to Atelier Ao, hehe!"
records.en: I made this based on a cauldron from another world. With some practice I can be an alchemist too! I'll secretly build my shop in the school. "Welcome to Atelier Ao, hehe!"
